mods.name: Scroll Bindings
mods.description: Adds scroll wheel keybinds to Minecraft.

releases.notes:
A client-side Fabric mod that lets you bind scroll wheel up/down to any keybind in Minecraft.

## Features
- Bind scroll wheel up and scroll wheel down to any in-game keybind
- Three modes: **Keybinds** (scroll triggers bound actions), **Vanilla** (default behavior), **Disabled** (scroll does nothing)
- Works directly through the vanilla Controls screen — no extra config menus
- Client-side only, no server required

## Requirements
- Minecraft **1.21.11**
- [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/) **0.18.4+**
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
- [Fabric Language Kotlin](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-language-kotlin)

## Installation
1. Install Fabric Loader and Fabric API
2. Drop `scroll-bindings.jar` into your `.minecraft/mods` folder
3. Launch the game — bind scroll in Controls settings
